notes.title: Update Notes for May 4, 2022
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Most levels are now easily accessible from menu in main office.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Teleport function added on both hands instead of one hand.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Cross street traffic moves slower allowing more time to escape being hit.
[/list]

notes.title: Full Release LIVE!
notes.notes:
Please provide feedback for improvements, questions, comments in the discussion section if necessary.

Updates and changes include:
[list]
[*] Ability to refuel bike at gas stations
[/list]
[list]
[*]Roads added to mountain range for driving, missions
[/list]
[list]
[*]Vehicle traffic on mountain roads
[/list]
[list]
[*]Mountain range added scenery with waterfall, plane crash, trees, small lake
[/list]
[list]
[*]Working menu options
[/list]
[list]
[*]Simplified steering to scooter with increased speed
[/list]
[list]
[*]Optimization for smoother gameplay
[/list]
[list]
[*]Video instructions for international players, no reading required
[/list]
[list]
[*]Improved radio
[/list]
[list]
[*]A few more simple animal encounters
[/list]

notes.title: LIVE UPDATE!
notes.notes:
No longer required to keep holding Grip button to steer bike.
Second option added to get around on foot. Choose Touchpad movement or Teleport.
